_comment: Panel-of-judges pipeline config. Credentials are ENV VAR NAMES, never values; keys live in the environment or a gitignored .env next to the harness.
routing_comment: `provider`/`id` is the native route and stays the default. The optional `openrouter` block is a fallback harness.resolve() takes only when the native key is absent; tags and panel membership are unchanged either way, and metrics.jsonl records the id actually called. OpenRouter mirror ids and prices verified against openrouter.ai/api/v1/models on 2026-08-17; OpenRouter has no Batch API, so a fallback-routed tag must run realtime.

panels._frontier_fast_note: calibration-loop panel (2026-08-17): deepseek replaces kimi as third seat -- K3 spends 8-18 min and 25-57k reasoning tokens per whole-doc call; V3.2 is frontier-class, open-weights, and fast. Seat confirmed by a 4-way audition on the v5 rubric (runlog-v5.jsonl, 5 cells each): V3.2 4/4 named-core hits at 28-86s/call with the sparsest positives; glm (GLM-5.2) 3/4 at 43-153s = designated substitute; deepseek-v4 (V4-Pro-0813) 4/4 but 93-1132s/call and 2-4x looser; qwen38-max 2 length-overflow parse failures. Production frontier/frontier_primary unchanged until the shipped data is regenerated.
panels._comment: frontier = every tag whose rows the site builder may admit (primaries AND substitutes). frontier_primary = the judges the run driver executes; substitutes (opus, kimi-k2) are run manually per Skill 4 when a primary fails.
panels._itest_note: single cheap judge for end-to-end integration testing (~2 cents per behaviour); never for published data. Must be a long-context model: whole-doc prompts reach ~65k tokens (qwen-small's 41k context cannot fit them).

param_quirks_comment: gpt-5*: max_completion_tokens + reasoning_effort (gpt-5.6: low, else minimal), no temperature. fable/mythos: no temperature. others: temperature=0.

display._comment: Behaviours shown in site/llm-panel-review. Display thresholds are CLIENT-SIDE (app.js URL params, defaults 6/6); threshold/solid_threshold here are unused legacy.
display._activation_note: The two general-guidelines slugs (animal-welfare-impacts, general-welfare-impacts-strict) join this list when the full rollout data lands; until then the dual-slug mapping in build_site_data.py is inert by design.

_opus_note: opus substitutes for fable on third-party-harm x model-spec only (fable output content-filtered there, 3 attempts); opus rows exist for no other cell.
